issues: Face shape categories list: The article lists six shapes, including diamond, yet cites the arXiv paper for category confusion. The evidence supports only five shapes (heart, oblong, oval, round, square), and the IdentiFace source doesn't support its claim that adding categories caused confusion between similar shapes. Needs correction.
